name: persistent-project-chat
goal: Always-visible chat bubble with working model requests and touched-unit history links.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Feature defines persistent bubble, general model requests, scoped unit history and Read/Comment/Write roles on every runtime; backend authority remains decisive.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing tests only offered creation chat on writable catalogs and universally denied hosted execution. Extended reference scenarios for entity/history bubble and circular shape, plus writer access membership.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Red d5322bf5 at this committed failing test 953aaddf: round chat bubble assertion fails. Paired green ae66c2d4 at separate fix d158979b uses unchanged inputs and environment.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Separate product fix d158979b: Opus shared launcher, web transport, history references and permission checks. Regression corpus unchanged.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Green ae66c2d4 at d158979b passed the unchanged tests and command under the same environment as red d5322bf5 at 953aaddf.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
